en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a Swedish Saab J35D "Draken" jet fighter landing or taking off with its drag parachute deployed. The aircraft bears the number 23 on the tail and Swedish roundels on the fuselage. Below the photo there is a white margin with Swedish text giving technical data for the J35D, the crest and wings emblem of the Swedish Air Force, and text identifying the unit Kungl Östgöta Flygflottilj F3 at Malmslätt.
